name: citation-lifecycle
title: Citation Lifecycle
description: Top-level citation status: Issued -> Responded -> InContest -> Adjudicated -> Closed.
machine_states: citation-lifecycle--adjudicated, citation-lifecycle--closed, citation-lifecycle--dismissed, citation-lifecycle--incontest, citation-lifecycle--issued, citation-lifecycle--responded
state_transitions: st-0002-cl-incontest, st-0002-cl-issued, st-0002-cl-responded, st-0003-cl-closed, st-0003-cl-issued, st-0004-cl-issued, st-0005-cl-closed, st-0005-cl-issued

name: contest-track
title: Contest / Hearing
description: Contest track: NotContested | HearingRequested -> Scheduled -> Heard.
machine_states: contest-track--dismissed, contest-track--heard, contest-track--hearingrequested, contest-track--notcontested, contest-track--reduced, contest-track--scheduled, contest-track--upheld, contest-track--withdrawn

name: payment-track
title: Payment / Penalty
description: Payment track: Pending -> Due -> Late -> Collections | Paid | NotOwed.
machine_states: payment-track--collections, payment-track--due, payment-track--late, payment-track--notowed, payment-track--paid, payment-track--pending
state_transition_rules: payment-track--collections->paid, payment-track--due->late, payment-track--due->paid, payment-track--late->collections, payment-track--paid->notowed, payment-track--pending->due, payment-track--pending->notowed
